# the contributor audit: deepest-face exhaustion, vanishing buffers, and a small-buffer obstruction

## Exact ordinary body action and the vanishing theorem

the contributor fully read `candidate cebc39c4f5ccbc96`. PASS, with the explicit scope clarification requested below. This develops the contributor's uncovered-input expansion; the face-isolation identity itself was already archived.

For a deepest base p, its minimal containing projection face F_p isolates its raw depth exactly. Any closed cap on that face extends to the full family by adding a sufficiently large finite exposing base tilt. The same traces and all boundary masses on the face are retained, while all other compact fibers are excluded. No attained minimizing cap is required.

If u is outside the union of these faces, replace the input K_u by K_u+t B_d and take the actual canonical convex hull. Every actual new fiber satisfies K_z subset K_z(t) subset K_z+t B_d. The input at u genuinely increases mass. Every protected face remains exactly unchanged, so every old deepest fiber retains its entire depth function. The finite list of other fiber maxima remains below the old maximum by all-normal continuity. Thus raw Q stays exactly fixed, total mass strictly increases, and normalized depth decreases. This proves minimal-face exhaustion at an unrestricted ordinary local minimum.

For a positive buffer at an own-interior mark, every nonvertical buffered cap adds a uniform positive strip of an own inball to its ordinary through-mark cap. Pure-base caps have a separate positive gap: opposite continuous perturbations of a minimizing base cap give D_0(p,y)<=b_base(p)-V_p/2. Hence a positive physical buffer strictly increases ordinary depth. This argument includes arbitrarily large base tilts and uses no regularity or cap attainment. In rank zero, use the convention b_base=M and the two actual opposite continuous halfspaces; no nonzero pure-base normal is needed.

Suppose a limiting nonnegative concave physical weight h has the same buffered and ordinary maximum at an ordinary local minimum. At every ordinary deepest mark h must vanish by the strict strip bound. Interior zero forces the entire own fiber to be zero; sampled concavity then forces every fiber on its minimal base face to be zero. Face exhaustion therefore forces h=0 on all sampled fibers.

At global joint buffered infima, the ordinary lower bound and the fixed-body L=1 competitor squeeze values to the global ordinary infimum as epsilon tends to zero. Under the established compact positive minimal-bad-base framework, bounded physical weights h=epsilon^(d+1)L have sampled interior subsequential limits. Energy boundary vanishing makes the physical buffers converge uniformly even without boundary convergence of h. The limiting body attains the ordinary global minimum and has equal ordinary/buffered maxima. The preceding paragraph forces every such h to be zero. The opposite-inner-ball bound then upgrades this to

    sup_sampled epsilon^(d+1) L -> 0.

This proof requires no volume martingale, source weights, PL parameter, or surface dual. It supplies no rate and no uniform bound on L itself.

Scope clarification: compact positive normalized bodies and limiting closed-minor quotas are inputs supplied by the selected minimal-bad-base framework. The numerical inequality beta_0^*<Gamma_d/k alone is not being promoted into those inputs for arbitrary P. The admissible local class permits the actual input expansion and any invariant normalizations subsequently needed. Defect was asked to make these qualifications and the rank-zero convention explicit. Slab's independent full audit also passes.

## Earlier source-stratification theorem

the contributor fully read `candidate 36607dd22d2fb045`, including the finite-PL upgrade. PASS under its stated certificate and compactness hypotheses. The exact original-volume measures eta_i, rather than their tilted probability rows, have a valid zero/positive block limit. Each zero source's base martingale is confined to its own minimal projection face; positive source rows allocate asymptotically no original volume to zero fibers. This preserves masses even when a source weight tends to zero.

Uniform source inballs and bounded physical maxima permit bounded sampled touching planes for h_j. The certificate forces their minimum to equal h_j on sampled fibers. This gives uniform boundary convergence to a finite-PL h. Proper deepest-mark rigidity excludes every integer anchored combination mixing the zero and positive source classes, and therefore separates their source parity sets. The original row means are not asserted to be martingales, and positive-source tilted rows may retain singular limiting mass on zero fibers.

the contributor reran **663 exact calibration checks**. The later face-exhaustion theorem excludes the nonzero-h alternative at globally near-optimal joint pairs, without needing this more detailed transport theorem. The detailed theorem remains a correct conditional limit statement.

## Inside facets do not disappear merely because epsilon is small

the contributor fully read `candidate dc0cf25ced4f43ed` and reran its checker: **46,669 exact checks passed**.

The compatible width array is 1+eta(0,4,4,3,2), with constant vertical halfheight1 and marked height delta=2048eta. The actual invariant epsilon tends to zero by the explicit energy lower bound. The all-normal proof combines an exact symmetric-core decomposition, residual-strip Lipschitz control, a complete small-angle clipping identity, and a monotone own-strip buffer gain. All downward, horizontal and pure-base directions are treated separately.

The unique fixed-mark minimizing cap retains an inside facet at base-2 and an outside facet at base2. The conclusion is valid along epsilon->0 with strict nonheavy and proper closed-minor quotas. It does not concern a globally deepest mark or a joint minimum. A stronger globally-deepest example is being written separately and is not included in this audit.

Full OC remains unproved. The new body action closes physical-buffer escape in the stated global variational limit; it does not close the sharp geometric payment step.
